get_assistants: list all available assistants from openai or azure using litellm get_assistants
create_assistants: create a new assistant with a model, instructions, name, and tools like code_interpreter
delete_assistant: delete an existing assistant by its assistant_id using litellm delete_assistant
create_thread: create a new thread with an initial user message using litellm create_thread
run_thread: run a thread with an assistant and optionally stream the response using litellm run_thread
